title: Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy Schedule of Limits and Coverage Features by Tier
content:
The Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy is written at six tiers, Larkspur Umbrella 1M, 2M, 3M, 4M, 5M and 10M. Each tier carries the limits and coverage features scheduled below. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Coverage feature | 1M | 2M | 3M | 4M | 5M | 10M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Umbrella limit, each occurrence | $1000000 | $2000000 | $3000000 | $4000000 | $5000000 | $10000000 |
| Self-insured retention | $1000 | $1000 | $1000 | $500 | $500 | $250 |
| Defense costs paid in addition to the umbrella limit | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Excess uninsured and underinsured motorist limit | $0 (not included) | $0 (not included) | $1000000 | $1000000 | $1000000 | $2000000 |
| Nonprofit director and officer liability limit | $0 (excluded) | $0 (excluded) | $0 (excluded) | $1000000 | $1000000 | $2000000 |
| Occurrences anywhere in the world covered | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Personal injury (libel, slander, false arrest, invasion of privacy) covered | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Liability from golf carts used on a course covered | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Umbrella drops down to pay the part of a loss an unmaintained underlying policy would have paid | No | No | No | No | No | No |

## What each line of the schedule means

- **Umbrella limit, each occurrence.** The most the umbrella pays for any one occurrence.
- **Self-insured retention.** The retained amount the insured bears on a covered occurrence that no underlying policy covers.
- **Defense costs in addition to the limit.** Where the answer is Yes, defense costs are paid on top of the umbrella limit rather than out of it.
- **Excess uninsured and underinsured motorist limit.** A figure of $0 means the tier does not include this coverage.
- **Nonprofit director and officer liability limit.** The limit for the insured's liability arising from service as an unpaid director or officer of a nonprofit. A figure of $0 means that liability is excluded on the tier.
- **Worldwide coverage, personal injury, golf carts.** Where the answer is Yes, the tier covers that occurrence or that liability.
- **Drop-down for an unmaintained underlying policy.** Where the answer is No, the umbrella does not pay the part of a loss that an underlying policy the insured did not maintain would have paid.

## Reading the schedule

**Which tiers carry an excess uninsured and underinsured motorist limit?** Larkspur Umbrella 3M, 4M and 5M at $1000000, and Larkspur Umbrella 10M at $2000000. Larkspur Umbrella 1M and 2M carry $0, meaning the coverage is not included.

**Which tiers cover nonprofit director and officer liability?** Larkspur Umbrella 4M and 5M at $1000000 and Larkspur Umbrella 10M at $2000000. On 1M, 2M and 3M the limit is $0 and the liability is excluded.

**On which tier are golf carts used on a course not covered?** Larkspur Umbrella 1M only.

**Does the retention differ by tier?** Yes: $1000 on 1M, 2M and 3M; $500 on 4M and 5M; $250 on 10M.
